tasks.instructions: Directions: Read the passage and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.

passage.title: Reading Part 1 - Test 02
passage.text:
TEXT A - Local News

New Central Park Opens This Weekend

The city's newest recreational facility will open Saturday at 10 AM. This represents a significant investment in community wellness. Mayor Anderson says it will provide a vital green space for families. Local businesses have been generous in supporting the project.

TEXT B - Restaurant Review

La Bella Cucina ★★★★☆

The ambiance was warm and inviting with soft lighting. The menu offers an extensive selection of authentic Italian dishes. My seafood risotto was exquisite. The service was attentive without being intrusive. Highly recommended!

TEXT C - Apartment Notice

IMPORTANT: Elevator Maintenance

We are scheduling essential elevator maintenance next week. This work is mandatory for safety. If you have mobility issues, contact the manager. We appreciate your cooperation.
